title: 38_143685_box7_Incident_Summaries_1-100
doc_notes: This document is a collection of declassified incident summaries regarding unidentified flying objects, containing checklists and witness reports from 1946-1948.

incidents.summary: Two silver disc-like objects observed moving north at 8000 ft, followed by a third object performing tight circles.
incidents.quote: 2 silver objects of either spherical or disc-like shape

incidents.summary: Metallic object observed oscillating from intermediate altitude to near ground and climbing again.
incidents.location_name: Muroc Army Air Field, Muroc, California
incidents.quote: The object moved from an intermediate altitude in an oscillating fashion

incidents.summary: Yellowish white sphere observed oscillating in a forward whirling movement.
incidents.location_name: Muroc Army Air Field, Muroc, California
incidents.quote: oscillating in a forward whirling movement without losing altitude

incidents.summary: Rounded silvery object observed descending with rotation or oscillation.
incidents.quote: distinct ovular outline, with two (2) projections on the upper surface
